note: Control points authored by scanning mid.webp's actual gold-inlay pixels (R>150, G<R, B<G-10, R-B>60) in horizontal bands and taking each band's gold-pixel centroid. Points below progress~0.65 are directly traced from the art; the last two points (approaching the gate) are extrapolated toward the fortress gate's authored screen position (x=0.525) since the trace loses the path into ambient background gold detail above that point. Coordinates are lateral fraction (0.5 = center, matching the existing avatarX formula's 0..1 space before the *0.22 scale) and progress (0..1 along the corridor).
